questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. LIMPID
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

LIMPID
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Lucid'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'Limpid' is 'Lucid'.
  • Limpid: (used about a style of writing, expression, etc.) easily understood; clear. ((अभिव्यक्ति, लेखन शैली आदि के लिए प्रयुक्त) स्पष्ट, प्रसादगुणयुक्त,सहज)
    • Example: She gave him a look of limpid honesty.
  • Lucid: (used about something that is said or written) clear and easy to understand. ((भाषण या लेखन) समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट और सरल, सुबोध)
    • Example: It was a lucid dream; half awake, half asleep.
       

Correct Answer: Lucid.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Blunt: (used about a knife, pencil, tool, etc.) without a sharp edge or point. ((चाक़ू आदि) कुंद, भोथरा)
    • Obscure: not well known. (अप्रसिद्घ)
    • Subtle: not very noticeable; not very strong or bright. (बहुत गाढ़ा या चमकदार नहीं, हलका सूक्ष्‍म, बारीक)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Obtrusive
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Obtrusive
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Prominent'.

Key Points

  • The given word 'Obtrusive 'means noticeable in an annoying or unpleasant way.(अप्रिय रूप से स्पष्ट)
    • Example: The logo was still visible but less obtrusive this time in olive green.
  • The marked option Prominent means noticeable; easy to see(साफ़ दीखने वाला; जो आसानी से दीख सके)
  • From the meanings of these given words, it is clear that obtrusive and prominent are synonyms of each other.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Additional Information

  • Pervasive: spread throughout so thoroughly as to be seen or felt everywhere.
    • Usage: Playing video games is pervasive among kids. 
  • Exclusive: excluding or not admitting other things.
    • Usage: An exclusive focus on success and making money.
  • Modest: unassuming in the estimation of one's abilities or achievements.
    • Usage: He was a very modest man, refusing to take any credit for the enterprise.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. DELICATE

DELICATE
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is Frail.

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given word:-

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. OUTRAGED
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

OUTRAGED
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is Angry.

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given word:-

  • Let's look at the meaning of the words given in options:-

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. GRACEFUL

questions.question: Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Sacred

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. IMPLORE
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

IMPLORE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- '​Plead'
Key Points
  • The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'IMPLORE' is  'Plead'.
  • IMPLORE: to ask someone to do or not do something in a very sincere, emotional, and determined way (किसी को बहुत ईमानदार, भावनात्मक और निर्धारित तरीके से कुछ करने या न करने के लिए कहना) 
    • Example: She implored her parents not to send her away to school.
  • Plead: to make an urgent, emotional statement or request for something (कुछ के लिए एक जरूरी, भावनात्मक बयान या अनुरोध करने के लिए) 
    • Example: He was on his knees, pleading for mercy/forgiveness.
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information    Let's look at the meaning of other words:

  • Refuse: to say that you will not do or accept something (यह कहना कि आप कुछ नहीं करेंगे या स्वीकार नहीं करेंगे)
  • Answer: a reaction to a question, letter, phone call, etc. (किसी प्रश्न, पत्र, फोन कॉल आदि की प्रतिक्रिया)
  • Apologize: to tell someone that you are sorry for having done something that has caused problems or unhappiness for them (किसी को यह बताने के लिए कि आपको कुछ ऐसा करने के लिए खेद है जिससे उन्हें परेशानी या दुख हुआ हो)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. APPEASE

APPEASE

  • 'Appease' means pacify or placate (someone) by acceding to their demands.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Innate

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. STERN

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. HARDLY
questions.questionHtml:

HARDLY
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Barely.

  •  Hardly is an adverb that means almost no, almost not, or none.
  • The meaning of the given options are as follows -

    • Roughly - In a violent way.
    • Barely - Almost no.

    • Roughly -  हिंसक तरीके से।
    • Barely -  लगभग नहीं।
    • Strongly - मजबूत, स्वस्थ, ऊर्जावान।
  • उपरोक्त अर्थों से स्पष्ट है कि hardly का सही पर्यायवाची barely है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. SMUDGE
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

SMUDGE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'stain'. 

Key Points

  • Smudge is a noun which means a blurred or smeared mark on the surface of something (किसी चीज की सतह पर धुंधला या धुंधला निशान।).
    • Example - There was a faint smudge of scarlet below the pressure lock.
  • The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
    • stain - a colored patch or dirty mark that is difficult to remove. (एक रंगीन पैच या गंदा निशान जिसे हटाना मुश्किल है।)
    • sweet - having the pleasant taste characteristic of sugar or honey; not salt, sour, or bitter. (चीनी या शहद के सुखद स्वाद की विशेषता होना; नमक, खट्टा या कड़वा नहीं।)
    • trash - waste material; refuse. (कचरा)
    • mud - soft, sticky matter resulting from the mixing of earth and water. (कीचड़)
  • From the above meanings it is evident that stain is the correct synonym for the word smudge.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. RAPTUROUS

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. SYMPTOMATIC
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

SYMPTOMATIC
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Characteristic'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'Symptomatic' is 'Characteristic'.
  • Symptomatic: serving as a symptom or sign, especially of something undesirable. (एक लक्षण या संकेत के रूप में कार्य करना, विशेष रूप से कुछ अवांछनीय)

  • Characterstic: a quality that is typical of somebody/something and that makes him/her/it different from other people or things. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का विशिष्‍ट लक्षण जिसके कारण वह अन्‍य व्‍यक्तियों से भिन्‍न लगता है; अभिलक्षण; विशेषता)
    • Example: Bananas have their own characteristic smell.
       

Correct Answer: Characteristic.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Optimistic: expecting good things to happen or something to be successful; showing this feeling. (आशावादी)
    • Strange: unusual or unexpected. (असामान्‍य या अप्रत्‍याशित; विचित्र; अजीब)
    • Atypical: not typical of a particular type, group, etc. (असामान्य)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. RABID

Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

RABID

questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. ALARM
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

ALARM
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Panic.'

Key Points

  • The given word 'Alarm' means a sudden feeling of fear or worry. (एकाएक उत्‍पन्‍न डर या चिंता; घबराहट)
    • Example: He stepped forward and she backed away in alarm.
  • ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
    • 'Ring' means the sound made by a bell; the action of ringing a bell. (घंटी की आवाज़; घंटी बजाने की क्रिया)
      • Example: He heard the school bell ring.
    • 'Panic' means a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully. (एकाएक उपजा डर जो नियंत्रित न हो सके और स्‍पष्‍टता से सोचने न दे; संत्रास, भीषिका, आतंक)
      • Example: The people in the movie theater began to panic and run for the exits when they smelled the smoke.
    • 'Wake' means to stop sleeping; to make somebody stop sleeping. (जागना, जाग जाना; किसी को जगाना, जगा देना)
      • Example: Wake me up at seven tomorrow.
    • 'Sound' means something that you hear or that can be heard. (आवाज़, ध्‍वनि)
      • Example: Dolphins use sound to communicate with each other.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Mistake Points

  • You may think that ring and wake can be the correct answer but they are not synonyms of Alarm. (please have a look at the meanings for better understanding)
  • The correct synonym of alarm is Panic.



Additional Information

  • The synonyms of the word 'Alarm' are "panic, anxiety, worry".
  • The antonyms of the word 'Alarm' are "anticipation, excitement, hope".

इसलिए, सही पर्याय अवसादग्रस्त है।

  • Example: He was depressed after losing the game.
